checks.behavior: New: a signed-out reader sees the landing in the RPG skin with the book name "Origins 3.2", the lesson title, and the school choice. A choice for Tutor Advantage shows only when the setting TUTOR_LESSON_URL_TEMPLATE exists. Each choice is 48 px high or more at 375 px. Legacy sends a signed-out reader to the sign-in page, with no book name (difference on purpose).
New: the school choice goes to the sign-in page and the address keeps callbackUrl=/en/b/o3-2/1. Legacy: the sign-in page has callbackUrl=/student/read/<id> (no locale).

A signed-in student scans the reading code. Legacy: the reading page of the article. New: the student lands in /student/lesson/<article> (the lesson flow), not on a 404 (difference on purpose, Member Question 2 default). The full sign-in from the landing (class code, card, password) is the browser check, cutover-check.mjs block "QR path".

New: a signed-out reader sees the landing with the book name and the line "Writing task". Legacy has no /writing route at bfea121, so the old printed writing code shows the generic not-found page (difference on purpose).

A signed-in student scans the writing code. Legacy: the article page (the old writing code does not exist, so this is the article page of the reading code). New: the student lands on /student/read/<article>, the page with the writing question.

A signed-in teacher scans the reading code. Legacy: the article page with the assign button. New: the lesson page of the first class that has Origins 3.2 (/teacher/class-roster/<class>/lessons/1). Run the class book browser check first so that the book is assigned. A teacher with no class for the book sees the "no class uses the book" page with a link to the class list. The staff sign-in with the callback is in the browser check.

New: the locale path /th/b/o3-2/1 loads the landing with no further redirect. The pair list needs a locale in every path, so the printed form with no locale (/b/o3-2/1) is a curl check in acceptance.md: one 307 to /th/b/o3-2/1 that keeps the path and the query.

New: an unknown book key shows the "book not known" page with a link to the student home; status is not 5xx. Legacy has no /b route; an unknown article id is the reference for an error page (difference on purpose).
New: lesson 999 of Origins 3.2 shows the "no such lesson" page with the book name and the range "Lessons 1 to 14"; status is not 5xx.
